text:
Applied the Gate 2 decisions to `.sdlc/runs/20261104-refactor-react18-only/requirements.md`:

1. **`@backstage/cli-module-new` bump level**: Reversed to `patch` (since template changes only affect newly scaffolded packages and do not break existing adopters). Updated `FR-7`, `NFR-3`, and `AC-6` counts accordingly (`17` `major`, `40` `minor` below `1.0.0`, and `2` `patch` for `@backstage/cli-module-new` and `@backstage/ui`).
2. **6-changeset split & plain adopter language**: Updated `FR-7`, `NFR-3`, and `AC-6` to specify the 6 separate changeset files ((a)–(f)), plain adopter language without internal code symbols (allowing `legacyRoot` for `@backstage/test-utils`), and the highest-bump rule when a package appears in multiple changesets.
3. **Report regeneration via repo scripts & CI check**: Updated `FR-3`, `FR-5`, `FR-6`, `FR-7`, `NFR-4`, `NFR-6`, and `AC-6` so `report.api.md` and `knip-report.md` are never hand-edited, are regenerated using `yarn build:api-reports` and `yarn build:knip-reports` (writing only report files inside the allowlist), and are verified with `yarn build:api-reports:only --ci packages/test-utils && yarn build:knip-reports --ci packages/cli-module-build plugins/app`.
